svg.text: ESP32-C6: chip up, USB this way
Step 10: Meter checks, where the probes go
top side, nothing plugged in. Black probe stays on TP5 (GND). Red probe on each numbered point in turn.
Black probe on TP5 (GND) for every check
Beep mode: red probe on each. Expect NO beep (a short chirp at 2 and 3 is the caps charging)
Diode mode: red on TP4, black on TP5. "OL" is right; 0.7–0.9 V means D4 is backwards
Then flip the board: look for solder bridges, leads trimmed to 1.8 mm or less
